description: Foxconn T77W676 (Snapdragon X12 LTE-A, Cat.9/12): family base, never matched itself; sold as Telit LN940 (1bc7:1900 QMI / 1901 MBIM) and HP lt4220 (03f0:0857 / 03f0:0a57). Not the T77W968 (that twin is the LN960): never apply T77W968 or LN960 procedures here. QMI/MBIM is chosen by an AT command on this module (AT^SETMODE, a persistent composition change: operator-only). ModemManager owns it: the Telit identity gets ModemManager's Telit plugin, the HP identity only the generic one (no plugin lists VID 03f0). Linux 6.12 and master know the Telit IDs (option + qmi_wwan on interface 1 for 1900) but not the HP IDs, so on 03f0 only the MBIM class driver binds by itself; QMI and the ttys need a new_id, which we do not do automatically. AT port numbers are not documented: probed, not hinted. Radio over AT is left undeclared: bands answer AT^SLBAND? / AT^SLBAND=LTE,<list> like the T77W968, but its AT^SLMODE codes are not established, so the T77W968 dialect is not reused. Telemetry seen in the field: AT^CA_INFO?, AT^RFSTS?, AT+TEMP. Field: long USB cables (2-3 m) failed to enumerate it, a USB hub power loss left the ports dead until another power cycle

recovery.source: 4PDA topic 994474 post 7485 (other scripts router: after a USB hub power loss the ports did not come up until another power cycle); docs/modem-zoo/4PDA-FIELD-NOTES.md
